fs-fire-water.front: What must stand by while a campfire burns?
fs-fire-water.back: At least 8 litres of water or a hand tool (check the current order wording).

fs-fire-bans.back: The BC Wildfire Service ban status for your fire centre.

fs-fire-fine.front: Fine for breaking an open fire ban?
fs-fire-fine.back: Up to $1,150. An escaped fire causing a wildfire: up to $1 million, jail and firefighting costs.

fs-fire-snap.front: How do you test if a stick is dry?
fs-fire-snap.back: Dry dead wood snaps. Wet or green wood bends.

fs-fire-pitch.back: Resin soaked wood from old pine or fir stumps and knots. Burns even when the outside is wet.

fs-fire-ladder.back: Tinder, matchstick, pencil, thumb, wrist. 2 big handfuls of each before you light.

fs-fire-door.front: Where is the door of the tipi?
fs-fire-door.back: On the upwind side, so wind feeds air into the tinder.

fs-fire-light.front: Where do you light the tinder?
fs-fire-light.back: Low, at the bottom, from the upwind side, shielded by your body.

fs-fire-signal.front: How do you make signal smoke by day?
fs-fire-signal.back: Green boughs on a hot fire, in the open. Three fires mean help.
fs-fire-signal.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Signal fire: by day, green boughs on a hot fire make thick smoke that aircraft can see. Build it in an open spot.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Signal fire: smoke by day</text><rect x="0" y="220" width="400" height="80" rx="0" fill="#dfe6d3"/><line x1="164" y1="214" x2="231" y2="203" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="12.6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="169" y1="203" x2="236" y2="214" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="12.6" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M178 204 Q171 168 200 137 Q229 168 222 204 Z" fill="#e8590c"/><path d="M189 204 Q186 185 200 166 Q214 185 211 204 Z" fill="#f6c344"/><path d="M190 140 C170 100 230 80 200 50" fill="none" stroke="#9a9a8f" stroke-width="20" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M210 150 C240 110 180 90 220 60" fill="none" stroke="#bdbdb4" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><rect x="317" y="206" width="6" height="14" rx="0" fill="#8b5a2b"/><polygon points="320,150 304,206 336,206" fill="#8a9a6b"/><text x="320" y="250" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Green boughs</text><text x="320" y="268" font-size="15" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">make white smoke</text><text x="80" y="120" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Open spot</text><text x="80" y="140" font-size="15" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">seen from air</text>
</svg>

fs-fire-out.front: Putting a fire out in 4 words?
fs-fire-out.back: Drown, stir, feel, repeat. Cool to the touch everywhere.
fs-fire-out.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Put it out step 3: hold the back of your hand close, then touch the ashes. They must be cool to the touch.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">3. Feel it</text><rect x="0" y="220" width="400" height="80" rx="0" fill="#dfe6d3"/><rect x="130" y="200" width="140" height="18" rx="6" fill="#777"/><ellipse cx="200" cy="186" rx="31" ry="18" fill="#d9b48f" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="200" y="120" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d32" text-anchor="middle">Cool to the touch</text><text x="200" y="288" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Cool to the touch, everywhere</text>
</svg>
